dslRule:
<!id: jdt.imethod.exists.guard>
<!description: Add method.exists() guard before calling isConstructor() to prevent issues with non-existent methods, improving robustness for JDT Core IMethod usages.>
<!severity: INFO>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.viewsupport.JavaElementLabels.getFlag($flags, org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.viewsupport.JavaElementLabels.T_TYPE_PARAMETERS) && $method.isConstructor() :: instanceof($method, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IMethod")
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.viewsupport.JavaElementLabels.getFlag($flags, org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.viewsupport.JavaElementLabels.T_TYPE_PARAMETERS) && $method.exists() && $method.isConstructor()
;;
summary: Adds a '.exists()' check to IMethod before calling '.isConstructor()' when also checking for type parameters.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
